scope: Local regression gates, not a general model quality benchmark or formal equivalence proof
reference: same quantization and fixed diagnostic engine, ROCBLAS_USE_HIPBLASLT=0 (Tensile), WMMA=0, suffix/chain=0; new logits required
kernel: existing attention/MMQ/parity test criteria remain unchanged

teacher_forced.continuation: Fixed historical baseline normal-generation IDs, used only as shared teacher-forced inputs; new Tensile logits are the numerical reference.
teacher_forced.sampling: temperature=0, top_k=1, top_p=1, min_p=0, seed=42; no penalties
teacher_forced.baseline_repeat: new independent Tensile teacher-forced repeat required; no use of historical default-backend logits as acceptance reference

categories: Python code with deterministic unit cases
tasks.cancel_retry: cancel in-flight generation and verify retry completes normally without engine restart

performance: screening timings are diagnostic; final acceptance requires >=5 interleaved pairs in >=2 sessions and the Goal performance gates
